Each tutorial has about 40 minutes of pen-and-paper work followed by 40 minutes in a Jupyter notebook. Do the calculation first; then use the notebook to check it and vary the example. Bring a laptop.

## Assignments

Three take-home assignments extend the tutorial work:

| # | Out after | Built from | Deliverable |
|---|:---:|-----------|----------|
| A1 | L11 | T5 | Extend micrograd, verify gradients against PyTorch, and document gradient checks |
| A2 | L21 | T10–T11 | Model and solve three real problems with CVXPY; certify optimality via KKT |
| A3 | L24 | T12–T13 | Build a Huffman compressor and an n-gram language model; compare bits/char against entropy and cross-entropy |
